experimentalAutoAlign.name: Experimental Auto Align
experimentalAutoAlign.description: Aligns cell contents to the top if there is text wrapping.

isSortable.name: Sortable
isSortable.description: Whether the table can be sorted by its headers.

overflowMenuOnHover.name: Overflow Menu On Hover
overflowMenuOnHover.description: Whether the overflow menu is shown only on hover.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: Whether the selection control is a radio button instead of an inline checkbox.

stickyHeader.name: Sticky Header
stickyHeader.description: Whether the header should be sticky.

useStaticWidth.name: Use Static Width
useStaticWidth.description: If true, sets the table width to auto instead of 100%.
